# Palm Valley Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics

> PVPD is a pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice serving Arizona with advanced clinical services, sedation options, and specialized care for children and adults.

Palm Valley Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics (PVPD) operates multiple locations across Arizona including Scottsdale, Chandler, East Mesa, Mesa, Surprise, Goodyear, and Buckeye. The practice specializes in pediatric dentistry, orthodontics, and advanced treatments like sedation dentistry, airway expansion, and special needs care.
